name: I Date Good or Evil at Hero’s College
source:
My name is Lloyd Richardson. First year student studying at Coundon City College. This college is best known for its medical studies, travel & tourism, and the famous public services… for young superheroes. As my life with no-born powers is going smoothly with my studies, everything changes when these two student girls enter my life.

The popular and full-of-herself, Hayley Bright, also known as the newest heroine called Flarebay. And the outcast but nice Gracie Scales, also known as the criminal: GreenClaw, her secret identity.

From plain and same casual life into a comedy-drama of new romance, secrets, struggles, facing the main story villain, and getting to know the hero's life in the city of Coundon! 

[From [url=https://bus-arrows-studios.itch.io/heroscollege]itch.io[/url]]
